feature: Marketing Manager Audit - selfrules.org Growth Strategy
workflow_rationale: This is a pure research and analysis task with strategic documentation as output. No code changes required. The investigation workflow fits because we need to analyze the current state, identify gaps, and produce strategic recommendations.

phases.name: Current State Analysis
phases.description: Analyze selfrules.org current positioning, messaging hierarchy, and value proposition clarity

subtasks.description: Analyze website positioning and messaging hierarchy
analysis_focus: Is the primary headline clear and differentiated?
Does the value proposition hierarchy make sense?
Are the CTAs effective and low-friction?
Is the tone consistent across sections?

verification.instructions: Document findings in positioning_analysis section of audit report

subtasks.notes: Completed comprehensive positioning analysis. Key findings: 8.4/10 overall positioning score. Strengths: unique "failure-to-translator" narrative, consistent pragmatic voice, strong proof stacking, low-friction CTAs. Opportunities: missing email capture, generic hero stats, limited conversion paths. Documented in MARKETING_AUDIT_REPORT.md.

analysis_focus: Awareness: How do strangers discover the site?
Consideration: What content builds trust?
Decision: What triggers booking?
Retention: What keeps them engaged?
Advocacy: What drives referrals?

verification.instructions: Complete customer journey map with gaps identified at each stage

subtasks.notes: Completed comprehensive customer journey mapping across all 5 stages (Awareness→Advocacy). Key findings: Strong consideration stage (8/10) with weak awareness (4/10), retention (2/10), and advocacy (2/10). Critical gaps: no blog/content for SEO, no email capture, no retention mechanism, no referral program. Documented complete touchpoint inventory, gap severity assessment, and stage-specific recommendations in MARKETING_AUDIT_REPORT.md.

subtasks.description: Audit current growth loops and AARRR funnel
analysis_focus: Viral/UGC Loop: Does content get shared? Is there user-generated content?
Content/SEO Loop: Is blog driving organic traffic?
Paid Acquisition Loop: Any paid channels active?
Sales/Referral Loop: Is there a referral mechanism?
AARRR metrics at each stage

verification.instructions: Complete Growth Loop Assessment table with status and potential for each loop type

subtasks.notes: Growth Loop Assessment and AARRR Funnel analysis already completed in MARKETING_AUDIT_REPORT.md (lines 596-1214). Key findings: Primary loop recommendation is Content/SEO + Sales/Referral (Dual Engine). AARRR shows strong Activation (8/10) but critical gaps in Acquisition (4/10), Retention (2/10), and Referral (2/10). Funnel leakage estimated at ~99.5% of potential value lost. Priority actions documented by stage.

phases.name: Competitive Benchmarking
phases.description: Benchmark against direct and indirect competitors to identify differentiation opportunities

subtasks.description: Analyze direct competitors (PM consultants, freelancer platforms)
analysis_focus: Direct: Toptal, Product People Europe, freelancer platforms
Positioning differences and unique angles
Pricing models and value propositions
Content and thought leadership strategies
subtasks.notes: Completed comprehensive direct competitor analysis. Analyzed 5 competitor categories: 1) Talent Marketplaces (Toptal, Upwork, Fiverr) with pricing $25-150/hr, 2) Specialized PM Agencies (Product People Europe, SVPG) with premium pricing, 3) Individual PM Coaches (Ken Norton, Tim Herbig) with personal brand focus, 4) Fractional PM Services ($7-14K/month), 5) Italian Market (Product Heroes). Created competitive positioning matrix, pricing landscape visualization, content strategy comparison, and identified 5 key differentiation opportunities for selfrules.org: "Translator" category ownership, Italian market first-mover, anti-platform positioning, SVPG accessibility alternative, and micro-consulting innovation.

analysis_focus: Indirect: PM training programs, full-time hire alternative
What job-to-be-done are clients really hiring for?
Price anchoring opportunities
Differentiation through personal brand authenticity

verification.instructions: Complete indirect competitor analysis with positioning opportunities

subtasks.notes: Completed comprehensive indirect competitor analysis. Analyzed 4 indirect competitor categories: 1) Full-time PM hire (€100-150K total cost, 3-6mo hiring, 98%+ cost savings with Selfrules), 2) PM training programs (Product School, Reforge, Italian market options - all generic/delayed), 3) Internal promotion path (€60-100K investment, 18mo timeline, 30% failure risk), 4) DIY self-learning (cheap but no feedback/personalization). Created JTBD analysis with 3 primary jobs, price anchoring framework with 5 anchor statements, competitive battle cards for 5 scenarios, and 5 differentiation amplification recommendations. Added ~600 lines to MARKETING_AUDIT_REPORT.md.

phases.name: SWOT Analysis
phases.description: Synthesize all findings into comprehensive SWOT analysis

subtasks.description: Create SWOT analysis with 3-5 items per quadrant

deliverable_elements.weaknesses: Internal negative factors (missing growth loops, no email capture)
deliverable_elements.opportunities: External positive factors (market gaps, content marketing potential)

verification.instructions: SWOT has 3-5 specific, actionable items per quadrant grounded in website analysis

subtasks.notes: Completed comprehensive SWOT analysis with 5 items per quadrant: Strengths (S1-S5), Weaknesses (W1-W5), Opportunities (O1-O5), Threats (T1-T5). Added SWOT cross-analysis with strategic implications and prioritized 5 strategic priorities. ~400 lines added to MARKETING_AUDIT_REPORT.md.

phases.name: Strategy Development
phases.description: Create optimized positioning statement and 90-day growth strategy

subtasks.deliverable_format: For [target audience] who [need/problem], [name] is the [category] that [key differentiator] because [proof points]

verification.instructions: Positioning statement follows standard format completely with all 5 elements

subtasks.notes: Created comprehensive optimized positioning statement following standard format with all 5 required elements: (1) Target: Product Managers and cross-functional team leaders, (2) Need: design-dev-business alignment struggles, (3) Category: Product Management Translator (new category), (4) Differentiator: bridges gap because failed in all three, (5) Proof: 13 years experience + quantified client outcomes + low-friction offer. Added Italian version, short-form variants for different contexts, application guide, category creation strategy, and competitive positioning map. ~250 lines added to MARKETING_AUDIT_REPORT.md.

subtasks.description: Develop 90-day growth strategy with weekly priorities

deliverable_structure.week_1_4: Quick Wins - High impact, low effort actions

verification.instructions: Strategy includes specific actions, success metrics, and realistic timeline

subtasks.notes: Developed comprehensive 90-day growth strategy with detailed weekly priorities across 3 phases: Phase 1 (Weeks 1-4) Quick Wins - email capture, LinkedIn optimization, first 3 blog posts, testimonial activation; Phase 2 (Weeks 5-8) Strategic - referral system, email nurture, SEO optimization, content pillar; Phase 3 (Weeks 9-12) Transformational - podcast guest tour, partnerships, community building, automation. Includes specific daily actions, success metrics per week, investment requirements, risk mitigation, and 90-day success criteria. ~800 lines added to MARKETING_AUDIT_REPORT.md.

verification.instructions: Channel prioritization table with scores and recommendations

subtasks.notes: Completed comprehensive channel prioritization analysis using the Growth Channel Score Formula (Reach × (10-Cost) × Control / 100). Evaluated 9 channels: Email Newsletter (4.20 - Primary), LinkedIn (3.78 - Primary), Blog/SEO (3.60 - Primary), Referral Program (3.20 - Secondary), Twitter/X (1.75 - Opportunistic), Podcast Guesting (1.68 - Opportunistic), YouTube (1.12 - Defer), Speaking (0.72 - Defer), Paid Ads (0.54 - Not Recommended). Added visual prioritization matrix, resource allocation recommendation (~23.5 hrs/week), and 5 key strategic insights. ~500 lines added to MARKETING_AUDIT_REPORT.md.
